result.title: Beyond the Readout: A Latent Numerical Frame Shared Across Modality and Operation
result.summary: When a multimodal model computes 17+35 from text or 91-39 from a rendered image, it produces the same answer, 52. Does it use one internal concept of number for both, or separate machinery for each path? Similarity metrics such as RSA or CKA cannot settle this question. They give the same score to identical and to rotated directions, and two representations can look alike only because both prepare the same output digits. We therefore use causal interventions. For four conditions (text or image, addition or subtraction), we learn a small subspace of Gemma4-12B-it's residual stream in which swapping coordinates swaps the model's answer. The subspaces answer three questions. First, do the conditions write numbers along the same directions? They do not. Reusing a subspace from text in an image on the same operation recovers only 53.2% of its causal effect. A single rotation and rescaling maps one subspace onto the other and raises recovery to 91.4%, so the conditions share one geometry expressed in different coordinates. Second, does this shared geometry only reflect the digit the model is about to print? To test this, we split each subspace into 9 directions that the output layer reads to choose the next digit and 13 directions that it cannot see. The 13 hidden directions still carry the number, yet changing them barely alters the digit being written. Third, what are these hidden directions for? A model must emit a multi-digit answer one digit at a time, so it can compute the full result early and keep it in reserve. When two numbers share their first digit, swapping the number in the hidden directions leaves the digit being written intact and redirects the next digit in 77.6% of cases. The model thus forms an abstract numerical concept upstream and unfolds it across time: multimodal representations share meaning through relational geometry across distinct coordinate frames.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用因果干预在 Gemma4-12B-it 的残差流中学习可交换答案的数值子空间，比较文本/图像与加法/减法条件，并区分输出层可读与不可读的方向，发现多模态共享的是经旋转缩放的几何结构，隐藏方向保留完整数值并用于逐位输出。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接把 RSA/CKA 相似度与因果效应、读出可辨识性拆开，为视觉—语言 latent 内容是否真正参与计算及「表示相似但仅预备输出」的混淆提供了可核查的干预范式。
